title: Grand Traverse Parasail

services.name: Parasailing
services.desc: Come fly above the bay on our custom-designed parasail boat! Rates Early Bird Special: $99 | Special for 9 a.m. & 10:30 a.m. boats! Person: $109 Duration Up to 1 hour & 30 minutes | Dependent on the amount of flyers in the boat About Our flights are setup with up to 12 flyers boarding the boat for the 1.5 hour trip Up to three flyers in the chute at during one flight Maximum combined weight is 600 lbs Fly up to 800' above the water! Request to stay dry or ask for a dip and get your toes wet in East Bay (sometimes a little more than toes) Great for those hot summer days Each flight lasts 10-12 minutes No single
